official_definition: This Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects, except those of the opposing Spirit with 20px on it. Also, when an opposing Spirit/Ultimate with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's attacks, destroy that Spirit/Ultimate.

ownership_rules.native_syntax: Ability block header contains [G.A.T. Field] or [G.A.T. Field: Param]
ownership_rules.prose_exclusion: Mentions inside body clauses ("with [G.A.T. Field]", "give [G.A.T. Field]") classified as REFERENCES or GRANTED, never NATIVE.

resolution.description: Mutates game state as specified by official effect text.
